limits: Two one-shot answer sets; the same related model family is not an independent source of population-level validation.
The two variations on sampling units share data and text. A successful index export cannot establish whether an agent invoked a skill internally.
Both readers reached the score ceiling. Small deliberately diagnostic examples and an arm-blind case-writer adjudication do not establish incremental value or equivalence.
